AboutMe.Title: About & Engineering Approach
AboutMe.Paragraphs: I am an Applied AI Engineer based in Pittsburgh, PA, specializing in turning LLM capabilities into reliable, maintainable backend systems using Python, FastAPI, LangGraph, LangChain, and Google ADK. My work bridges the full lifecycle of AI engineering—from layout-aware document ingestion and vector retrieval pipelines to deterministic multi-agent orchestration and streaming APIs.

At Maly Tech Ltd, I contributed to the AI assistant embedded in Deloitte Middle East’s ME Tax Pulse, architected the AI4ALL multi-tenant agent prototyping platform, and built Luna, a RAG-powered financial assistant. Beyond proprietary client systems, I maintain open-source reference architectures that showcase strict port/adapter separation, Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) approval gates, and verifiable quote extraction.
